newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOODY'S ASSIGNS (P)PRIME-1 TO PEGASUS Y50 BLN CP.
newsitem.headline: MOODY'S ASSIGNS (P)PRIME-1 TO PEGASUS Y50 BLN CP.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Wednesday it had assigned a prospective rating of (P)Prime-1 to 50 billion yen in three-month commercial paper due November 1997 issued by Pegasus Funding Corp out of its 500 billion yen commercial paper programme.
The amount available for Pegasus to redeem the three-month CP at maturity may vary depending on the performance of a pool of loans originated by the Sumitomo Bank Ltd, Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's said the rating of the CP was based on a number of factors including the Prime-1 short-term deposit rating of Sumitomo Bank as the bank at which the proceeds of the CP are deposited.
Pegasus is a special-purpose company in the Cayman Islands, the rating agency said.
Sumitomo Bank's short-term and long-term deposits are rated Prime-1 and A1, respectively. The bank's financial strength rating is C, it said.
